subject: CareBridge security onboarding — SIG kickoff & clarifying questions
messages:
From: Katie Williams <katie.williams@carebridge.health>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@carebridge.health>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Quick follow-up from today's call — SIG initiation

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the demo today — good to meet you and Marissa. As discussed on the call, the procurement and security teams here at CareBridge would like to kick off a vendor security questionnaire (SIG preferred) and get clarity on a few compliance items before we proceed to procurement. I summarized the immediate asks below so we can align next steps: 

- SIG initiation: we'll send our SIG to you; if you have a prefilling option, we'd welcome that to speed the process.
- SOC 2: need to confirm whether Redwood has SOC 2 Type II and the coverage period; our legal will want the last report or a bridge letter if it's older than 12 months.
- HIPAA / BAA: CareBridge processes PHI. We need to confirm BAA availability and which environments would be covered (prod only or prod+staging).
- Data residency & GDPR: some customers are EU residents; please confirm whether EU data residency is supported or whether cross-border processing applies.
- Key management: question about customer-managed keys (BYOK) vs Redwood-managed keys — care our security team prefers control over master keys for PHI.
- Evidence format & access: What's the preferred mechanism for evidence exchange (S3 read links, shared Drive, direct upload to SIG portal)?
- Timeline: procurement is on a 6-week timeline — we'll need to know a realistic ETA for completing the SIG and collecting SOC2/pen-test evidence.

Would you and Marissa be able to propose a short mutual action plan and owners for each ask? If possible, please attach any prefills or templates you normally use.

Attachments: [attachment: CareBridge-SIG-v1.pdf (PDF, 128KB)]

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a 30-min follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Katie Williams
Head of Procurement, CareBridge Health
[katie.williams@carebridge.health]
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Katie Williams <katie.williams@carebridge.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's call — SIG initiation

Hi Katie — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the SIG. I pasted a short action plan below and a few clarifying questions that will help us scope the responses/evidence: 

Proposed near-term plan (owner / ETA):
- Redwoods SIG prefill + control mappings (owner: Marissa Cole) — ETA: 5 business days from today
- SOC 2 evidence & bridge letter check (owner: Ben Carter) — ETA: 3 business days to confirm availability, 10 business days for packaged evidence if requested
- BAA confirmation & scope (owner: Hannah Schmitt) — ETA: 2 business days to confirm standard BAA terms; 5 business days if bespoke language needed
- Evidence sharing mechanism & links (owner: Marissa) — ETA: 5 business days

Clarifying questions for scope (please reply inline where you can):
1) Can you confirm whether CareBridge processes PHI via uploads from end users, clinician notes, or both? (this affects our evidence scope)
2) For BAA coverage, do you need staging included or only production?
3) Is CareBridge requiring customer-managed keys (BYOK) for all datasets containing PHI, or is BYOK required only for a subset of customers/tenants?
4) For GDPR, do you need data residency guarantees (EU-only storage) or would standard EU SCCs + appropriate subprocessors be sufficient?
5) Is a redacted pen-test report sufficient, or do you require the full findings and remediation evidence?

I've attached our SIG prefilling spreadsheet to accelerate things — if you can provide the completed SIG PDF and any scope CSV you referenced, we can prefill and return within the ETA above.

Attachments: [attachment: redwood_sig_prefill.xlsx (XLSX, 34KB)]

Thanks — happy to set up a 30-min follow-up next week.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com
From: Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@carebridge.health>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's call — SIG initiation

Hannah / Marissa,

Quick answers to the questions — hope this helps with scoping: 
- PHI type: primarily user-submitted forms and clinician notes (both). We'll flag any integrations that ingest device telemetry separately.
- BAA scope: we need a BAA that covers production systems only; staging coverage would be optional but preferred.
- BYOK: CareBridge requires customer-managed keys for enterprise customers who opt into enhanced security — not universally required today, but it must be available as an option.
- GDPR: for our EU customers we generally require EU residency; SCCs are acceptable for some contracts but we have a few customers that require EU-only storage.
- Pen-test: redacted penetration test report is generally acceptable for legal review; we may request full findings for SOC 2 remediation mapping if necessary.

Our procurement timeline is still roughly 6 weeks, and we can commit to providing the SIG PDF back to you within 3 business days once we get the prefilling file. Attaching our internal scope file for reference.

Attachments: [attachment: carebridge_security_scope.csv (CSV, 6KB)]

Thanks,
Tom Rivera
Director, Vendor Security — CareBridge Health
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Katie Williams <katie.williams@carebridge.health>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@carebridge.health>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:44:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's call — SIG initiation

Perfect — thanks for the quick clarifications, Tom. Action items on our side and proposed due dates: 

- Marissa to prefill SIG spreadsheet and return with control mappings (Marissa) — due Wed, Dec 3, 2026
- Ben to confirm SOC 2 artifacts availability and provide a bridge letter if required (Ben) — due Tue, Dec 2, 2026
- Hannah to draft standard BAA language and confirm staging coverage options (Hannah) — due Tue, Dec 2, 2026
- CareBridge to return completed SIG PDF after our prefills (CareBridge) — target Fri, Dec 6, 2026

Sharing a mutual action plan folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C-carebridge-onboarding — we'll upload the prefills and a short readme with evidence expectations. If CareBridge prefers S3 links for evidence, please let us know the preferred mechanism and a small set of IAM principals we should expect for read access.

If there's anything urgent (e.g., specific contract language or an immediate need for a redacted pen-test), flag it in a reply and we'll expedite. Otherwise, I'll book a 30-min sync for Thu, Dec 4 to run through outstanding items — please share availability.

Thanks all — looking forward to moving this along.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
